claim: Amihan (NE monsoon) brings cool dry conditions roughly Nov-May; Habagat (SW monsoon) brings heavy rain Jun-Oct with worst rainfall Jul-Aug.
quote: The Amihan (northeast monsoon) lasts from November to May ... The Habagat season runs from June to October with warm, moist air and plenty of rain, with most rainfall happening in July and August

claim: San Agustin completed 1607 is the oldest stone church in the Philippines, inscribed by UNESCO in 1993.
quote: Completed in 1607, it is the oldest stone church in the country. In 1993, San Agustin Church was one of four Philippine churches... designated as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO.

claim: Old Manila Walks is the official operator of the Big Binondo Food Wok tour through the world's oldest Chinatown; booking via official site.
quote: Tours require prior reservation through the official website at oldmanilawalks.com

claim: Inaugural Michelin Guide Manila & Environs and Cebu 2026: 1 two-star, 8 one-stars (incl. Toyo, Gallery by Chele, Hapag), 25 Bib Gourmands.
quote: 1 Two Stars, 8 One Star & 25 Bib Gourmands

claim: Pampanga, 2h north, is the country's culinary capital: sisig at Aling Lucing's birthplace, Everybody's Cafe exotic dishes, Razon's halo-halo.
quote: Aling Lucing's Sisig ... Everybody's Café ... betute, kamaru, tapang kalabaw ... The Original Razon's | Halo-halo, pancit palabok

claim: The Traslacion on January 9 commemorates the transfer of the Black Nazarene image from Intramuros to Quiapo Church and draws millions.
quote: Every January 9, the Traslación of the Jesús Nazareno commemorates the 'solemn transfer' of the image's copy from San Nicolás de Tolentino in Intramuros to Quiapo.

claim: No direct Brussels-Manila flights; one-stop returns from around GBP 511 (~EUR 600).
quote: There are no airlines that fly direct from Brussels to Manila Ninoy Aquino, but flights with one stop are available from £511.

claim: Manila to Puerto Princesa (Palawan/El Nido gateway) is a direct ~1.5h domestic flight.
quote: A direct flight from Manila to Puerto Princesa takes about 1.5 hours

claim: Taal Volcano Island is a declared Permanent Danger Zone; crater landing/hiking is prohibited, only viewpoints and lake boat rides are possible.
quote: The Philippine Government has declared the Taal Volcano to be a 'Permanent Danger Zone' and access to the area is currently prohibited.

claim: Corregidor's main tour now runs from Mariveles, Bataan (Villa Carmen), ~$50 join-in, morning departures, advance booking mandatory.
quote: Villa Carmen in Mariveles, Bataan... Join-In Tour: $50... Morning Tour: 8:00 AM departure, 1:50 PM return... All guests must book before arrival

claim: The Manila Hotel opened 4 July 1912 in Californian Mission style and was the country's first five-star hotel.
quote: opened July 4, 1912, designed by architect William E. Parsons in Californian mission style ... the country's first ever five-star hotel

claim: The National Museum's three Manila museums (Fine Arts, Anthropology, Natural History) sit at Rizal Park and offer free admission.
quote: National Museum of Fine Arts, National Museum of Anthropology, and National Museum of Natural History ... P. Burgos Drive, Rizal Park, Manila

claim: Masungi Georeserve's Discovery Trail is a 3-4h reservation-only conservation trail (Php1700 weekday / Php2000 weekend), full payment to confirm.
quote: Php 1700.00/guest on weekdays ... Php 2000.00/guest on weekends ... 3-4 hours for the full round ... Terrain level 3

claim: The CCP main building is mid-rehabilitation, with pocket openings targeted for Q4 2026; resident companies play other venues meanwhile.
quote: CCP's rehabilitated building is set to commence its pocket openings by Q4 2026
